concept.title: Maps classification
concept.abstract: This section explains how repository structures, index files, Markdown organization, and heading hierarchies are converted into DITA maps and topic relationships. It covers scenarios including recommended folder structures, multiple Markdown files in a folder, and folders without index files. The AI Agent learns how to generate map hierarchies, topicrefs, topicheads, and parent-child navigation structures from repository organization.

conbody.p: In Markdown-based documentation systems, the folder hierarchy provides structural information that does not exist within the Markdown syntax itself. The Markdown-to-DITA converter analyses the directory structure containing the Markdown files and uses it to generate DITA maps, topic relationships, navigation hierarchies, and output filenames.
The converter considers both the physical folder structure and the heading hierarchy inside individual Markdown files to determine the DITA Map or Book Map structure.

The recommended authoring model for Markdown is listed below:
One logical topic per folder.
One primary index.md file per folder.
Child topics stored in subfolders.
Related assets stored in dedicated image or media folders.
